title: Training & Placement Cell | KPGU
content: Admission Inquiry Placement Training & Placement Cell ABOUT Training & Placement Career Development Overview The Training & Development cell is to empower students to achieve their career aspirations by providing them with the necessary support, guidance, and resources. The Centre is committed to promoting a culture of lifelong learning and to helping students acquire the skills and knowledge needed to succeed in a rapidly changing job market. The primary objective of T&P Cell is to provide students with a variety of career-related services, Placements and Industry exposure that will help them to prepare for, enter, and succeed in the workforce. GOALS Key Objectives To provide students with the resources, tools, and guidance they need to explore career options and make informed decisions. Objective To support students in their job search efforts and provide ongoing career support throughout their professional journey. Objective To assist students in developing the skills and competencies necessary to succeed in the workforce. Objective To connect students with potential employers and job opportunities. Objective To offer Industrial reach for students skilling Objective Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara. Approved by UGC, AICTE, PCI & AYUSH. Admissions, academics, research, campus life and student support in one place.
